text: How is the on-call schedule structured and who covers as backup?
reference_answer: On-call runs on a weekly cycle with a primary engineer and a secondary backup, coordinated in PagerDuty.

text: What happens between merging code and it reaching all users in production?
reference_answer: After CI passes on main, a canary deploy sends the build to a small slice of traffic before a full rollout.

text: If a release causes problems, how do we undo it quickly?
reference_answer: Redeploy the previous container image; one command reverts production to the last known-good build.

text: What distinguishes a top-priority incident from a minor one?
reference_answer: A SEV1 is a full customer-facing outage, while lower severities cover partial degradation or minor issues.

text: After a serious outage, what write-up is expected and by when?
reference_answer: A blameless postmortem is required within 48 hours of resolving a SEV1 or SEV2.

text: What availability do we guarantee to customers?
reference_answer: We target 99.9% monthly uptime for the core API.

text: Where should credentials and API keys be kept?
reference_answer: Store secrets in the vault; they are rotated every 90 days and never committed in plaintext.

text: How many reviewers must sign off before code can land?
reference_answer: Two approvals are required, and self-merging your own change is not allowed.

text: What is the safest way to release an experimental feature gradually?
reference_answer: Ship it behind a feature flag for a gradual rollout, with a kill switch to disable it instantly.

text: What is our plan if the main region goes down?
reference_answer: Fail over to a secondary region and restore from nightly backups within the recovery objective.

text: Where can I check live latency and error rates?
reference_answer: Grafana dashboards show latency, error rate and throughput for each service.

text: How do we change the database schema without downtime?
reference_answer: Ship backward-compatible Alembic migrations, expanding first and contracting later.

text: What should I write down when passing on the pager at the end of my shift?
reference_answer: Write handoff notes and leave any open incidents and follow-ups documented for the next engineer.

text: When does an unacknowledged page escalate to the backup engineer?
reference_answer: If the primary does not acknowledge within fifteen minutes the alert escalates to the secondary.

text: How do we check the system can handle a big traffic spike before a launch?
reference_answer: Run load tests against staging with k6 before a major launch.

text: What checks run automatically on every pull request?
reference_answer: The pipeline runs lint, unit tests and a build stage, and a failing stage blocks the merge.

text: What leave do new parents get here?
reference_answer: New parents get 16 weeks of paid parental leave, for birth or adoption.

text: How much paid time off do I get when I have a baby?
reference_answer: New parents get 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.

text: How much vacation do employees earn annually?
reference_answer: Employees accrue 15 days of paid vacation per year, added monthly.

text: How many vacation days do I get in a year?
reference_answer: Employees accrue 15 days of paid vacation per year.

text: What is the deadline to file expenses and when is a receipt needed?
reference_answer: File expenses within 30 days; a receipt is required for anything over $25.

text: When can I change my benefits elections?
reference_answer: During open enrollment each November, or after a qualifying life event.

text: How many days a week are we expected to come into the office?
reference_answer: We are hybrid, with two office days a week for people near an office.

text: Does the company contribute to retirement savings?
reference_answer: Yes, the 401(k) has a 4% company match with three-year vesting.

text: How many sick days can I take before I need a doctor's note?
reference_answer: Ten paid sick days a year; no doctor's note is needed for absences under three days.

text: How frequently are performance reviews carried out?
reference_answer: Twice a year, with a calibration step across teams.

text: What do I get for referring someone the company hires?
reference_answer: A 3,000 dollar referral bonus, paid after the new hire's first 90 days.

text: What does the paid holiday schedule look like?
reference_answer: Twelve paid holidays plus a company-wide winter break in late December.

text: What medical plans does the company offer?
reference_answer: A PPO and an HMO plan, with the company covering most of the premium.

text: How do I get reimbursed for a business trip?
reference_answer: File the expense within 30 days with a receipt for anything over $25.

text: What is the salary range for a senior engineer level?
reference_answer: An L5 senior engineer falls in a defined salary band within the L3 to L7 range.

text: What are the pay bands for engineers?
reference_answer: Compensation bands span levels L3 through L7, each with a salary range.

text: What are the company compensation bands?
reference_answer: Compensation bands span levels L3 through L7.

text: How often does the board meet and what gets sent beforehand?
reference_answer: The board meets quarterly, with a monthly metrics deck circulated ahead of each meeting.

text: What funding round are we on and how long is our runway?
reference_answer: We are raising a Series B and have about 24 months of runway.

text: What is our ARR goal for this year?
reference_answer: The target is to reach 20 million dollars of ARR by year end.

text: How many hires are planned this year and in which areas?
reference_answer: The hiring plan adds headcount across engineering, sales and support.

text: What are the company objectives this quarter?
reference_answer: This quarter focuses on enterprise expansion and platform reliability.
